milestones.title: Develop youth enterprise opportunities in Pulau Tanjung Aru
milestones.description: During the by-election campaign, Kurniawan pledged to prioritise youth jobs and work with KUSKOP on skills, microfinance and business guidance if elected.
milestones.progress_note: He subsequently became the Kinabatangan MP. This pass did not verify a matching programme launch, financing disbursement, employment count or completion deadline.

milestones.title: Prioritise renewal of Pulau Tanjung Aru community facilities
milestones.description: Kurniawan’s campaign statement committed attention to ageing infrastructure and proposed new mosque, hall and sports facilities, including futsal and volleyball spaces.
milestones.progress_note: A campaign undertaking, conditional on election at the time. Project approvals, budgets, construction and completed facilities were not verified after he took office; no invented deadline or percentage is assigned.

milestones.title: Advance 22 MIMOS technology releases toward readiness assessment
milestones.description: The report from the MIMOS technology preview describes another 22 technology-release packages progressing toward Technology Readiness Assessment by the end of 2026, in the deputy minister’s ministry portfolio.
milestones.progress_note: A reported agency pipeline, not the deputy minister’s sole delivery. The source was published 30 September with a 29 September dateline. Its 17 licensed packages, 29 ready releases and 22 in assessment are different cohorts, so no percentage is inferred. The year-only schedule uses 31 December as a display marker.

methodology: Commitments, documented activities and limited delivery reports are distinct. Evidence-only records have no invented earlier promise. Achieved covers the described handover, programme session or launch only. Shared agency responsibility, historical dates, count units, source limitations and missing follow-up evidence are explicit. No claim of exhaustive research is made.
